vibe: Elite, Data-Driven, Intense, High-contrast tactical. Rivaling Whoop, Strong, Hevy.

rules: Headings must be Uppercase with letter-spacing (tracking) for impact.
Data numbers (e.g. 225 lbs) must use Barlow Condensed Black or 900 weight.
Never center text by default. Align left for rapid scannability while working out.

layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px height for all interactive elements. Sweaty hands require large targets.
layout_and_spacing.surface_rules: No soft shadows. Use 1px solid stroke (border-[#2C2C2E]) on all cards. Background must be flat #161618.

workout_logging_card.style: Flat surface, strict grid. Left-aligned exercise name. High-contrast input fields for reps/lbs.
workout_logging_card.interactions: Highlight active set with a primary border (#FF3B30) or subtle #FF3B30 background tint.

voice_input_button.style: Massive FAB (Floating Action Button) or wide block at bottom. #FF3B30 background.
voice_input_button.active_state: When recording, display dynamic waveform using Reanimated. Outer glow box-shadow.

ai_coach_chat.ai_bubble: Background #0A0A0A, 1px border #2C2C2E, subtle left-border accent in #FF3B30.

charts_insights.style: Use react-native-chart-kit or Victory. Lines must be Electric Blaze (#FF3B30). Tooltips must be crisp, high contrast.
charts_insights.bar_charts: Max width for bars, tiny gaps, square corners.

icons.style: Sharp, medium weight. Use 'outline' variants for inactive, 'sharp' or filled for active states.
icons.color: Use #FFFFFF for active/primary icons, #A1A1AA for secondary.

image_urls.description: Cinematic close-up of matte black gym weights. Use as hero background for onboarding/auth or main splash screen.
Abstract 3D glowing particle orb. Use as the avatar for the Conversational Coach.
Minimalist dark aesthetic graph visualization. Use as background for the Goal Tracking & Projections empty state.
Row of dumbbells. Use as default thumbnail for logged strength workouts.

motion_and_interaction.active_states: All buttons must reduce opacity to 0.7 on press (React Native activeOpacity).
motion_and_interaction.voice_animation: When Voice Logging is active, pulse the record button from 1x to 1.2x scale, looping via React Native Reanimated.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Use Expo Router default slide-from-right iOS transitions for navigation.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='start-workout-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Since this is a React Native Expo environment, use standard StyleSheet.create for styling. Translate the provided hex codes and sizes into JS objects.
Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView from 'react-native'.
For iOS-first, ensure safe area padding using react-native-safe-area-context (SafeAreaView or useSafeAreaInsets).
For the bottom tab nav (using expo-router Tabs), set the tabBarStyle backgroundColor to #161618, borderTopColor to #2C2C2E, and activeTintColor to #FF3B30.
